answer: A newcomer joins only by hanging from a sponsor's branch in the public trust graph, and every admission is sealed with a cipher binding the newcomer to that branch, so lineage cannot be hidden. Each branch flies a lantern: a public tally of its proven fakes. At its zenith of three proven fakes, the whole branch freezes — no new admissions until the sponsor passes a live audit. One honest user needs a single sponsor once; a farmer wanting 1,000 puppets must grow 1,000 separate branches, each rooted in a sponsor with six months of history, or one fake freezes all 1,000 at once.
